Question 15
?

Given that y∈(−2,2), which of the following is equivalent to artanh⁡(−y2)?

a
12ln⁡(2−y2+y)
b
12ln⁡(y−2y+2)
c
12ln⁡(2+y2−y)
d
12ln⁡(y+2y−2)
e
12ln⁡(2y−12y+1)
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

The definition of artanh⁡x is artanh⁡x=12ln⁡(1+x1−x).

Therefore, artanh⁡(−y2)=12ln⁡(1+(−y2)1−(−y2))=12ln⁡(1−y21+y2)=12ln⁡(2−y22+y2)=12ln⁡(2−y2+y).
